Define the problem before designing the solution Language is only one part of the journey Evaluate three credible approaches Option 1: Translate the entire interface Option 2: Support multilingual search and understandable results Option 3: Rely more heavily on icons and visual cues What evidence would support this decision? A hypothetical software-product scenario How would we measure success? What if you only had two weeks? What evidence would make you reject your solution?
